title: 完整人工智能训练课程仓库
summary: 该仓库包含Prof. Fernando Amaral的完整人工智能训练课程内容，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、Agent、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等，提供理论和Python实践项目与笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete Artificial Intelligence Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, GenAI, NLP, Agents, CV, anomaly detection, genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic, with theory and hands-on Python projects and notebooks.
